note: Sub-annual editions (#1626 review). Register TEST (1, variant 2) has two 2020 editions, 2020-03-31 (regver 1) and 2020-12-31 (regver 2); Q (var 5) and S (var 6) are documented only in the 2020-12-31 edition. Both editions span the year 2020 as edition scopes but name different dates as edition-period scopes. The Q declaration names only the 2020-03-31 edition, a date SCB documents no Q on, so it mints its own c-q variable with one 2020-03-31 state beside v5's 2020-12-31 state. The S declaration's holdings_period 2020-12-01/2020-12-31 contains the documenting edition's date, so it is refused as column_now_documented and forms no c-s state.
fails_if: `scb_errata` compares edition scopes instead of edition-period scopes when deciding whether a declared column overlaps a documenting edition (the Q declaration refused because both 2020 editions span the year), or stops refusing a holdings_period that contains a documenting edition's date (c-s built)

sources.description: Two sub-annual 2020 editions; Q and S are documented only in the 2020-12-31 one.
